CustomField.description: Date the authority approved a software update under § 37 Abs. 6 Nr. 1 MessEG in conjunction with § 40 MessEV. Until this is filled the device may not legally operate even though its Eichfrist is untouched and unexpired - the most interesting state in the whole domain, and one the industry reports causes erhebliche Verzoegerungen. Note § 40 Abs. 4 MessEV also requires the operator to have CONSENTED to the update: a manufacturer pushing an OTA without consent is itself unlawful.
